metadata.name: VISAPUSHProvisioning
metadata.description: Use this API to generate encrypted payload for Push provisioning of a Visa Card details in the Payment APP(Google pay, Samsung pay etc.).

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition : At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition : At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: billingAddress
request_fields.description: Billing address associated with the payment instrument.

request_fields.name: name
request_fields.description: Full Name of Cardholder. Format: lastname/firstname or firstname lastname. Example: Jacob B Jonas Allowable Values: 28

request_fields.name: expirationDate
request_fields.description: Group with details of Expiration of Card

request_fields.name: clientAppID
request_fields.description: Unique identifier for the client application, used to provide some of the encrypted values. Issuer will configure the clientAppID value during the onboarding as defined in section 2.1 Required if intent is "0". Allowable Values: 36

request_fields.name: clientDeviceID
request_fields.description: "Stable device identification set by Wallet Provider. Could be computer identifier or ID tied to hardware such as TEE_ID or SE_ID. This field must match the clientDeviceID TWP will send in token provision request Required if intent is "0". " Format: String, alphabetic, numeric, hyphens ( - ), and underscores ( _ ), spaces are not allowed. Allowable Values: 24

request_fields.name: clientWalletProvider
request_fields.description: Client Wallet Provider is the token requestor’s ID (TRID), which is returned to the WP as part of onboarding. Format: String, alphabetic, numeric, hyphens ( - ), and underscores ( _ ), spaces are not allowed. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: clientWalletAccountID
request_fields.description: Client provided consumer ID that identifies the wallet account holder entity. When the wallet provider enrolls the PAN, clientDevicetId field should have the same value. Format: String, alphabetic, numeric, hyphens ( - ), and underscores ( _ ), spaces are not allowed. Allowable Values: 24

request_fields.name: intent
request_fields.description: The intent of the encryptor, which specifies what the encryptor of the data trying to do. Valid Values: PUSH_PROV_MOBILE=0, (Push the PAN data to a Token Requestor to provision a token for the card holder on a specific device for a specific wallet/account) PUSH_PROV_ONFILE=1 (Push the PAN data to a Card On File merchant/Token Requestor to provision a token for the cardholder) Example : 0

request_fields.name: IdentityVerificationRequired
request_fields.description: String field to specify if the Issuer wants Identity Verification to be performed. Valid Values: 'true' or 'false' Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: line1
request_fields.description: Address Line 1 for Cardholder Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 1 Meca Way Allowable Values: 140

request_fields.name: line2
request_fields.description: Address Line 2 for Cardholder Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example:15 Penang Street Point Allowable Values: 140

request_fields.name: city
request_fields.description: Cardholder's City of residence Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Norcross Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: state
request_fields.description: Cardholder State of residence Valid values are A-Z, a-z Example: GA Please refer Appendix Section : State Codes (US) Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: postalCode
request_fields.description: Cardholder Postal Code of Residence Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 30093 Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: country
request_fields.description: Two Character Country Code Valid values :A-Z, a-z Example: US Refer Appendix section : Country Code Values Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: month
request_fields.description: Expiration Month of the card. Valid Values: 0-9 DateFormat : MM Example : 09 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: year
request_fields.description: Expiration Year of the card. Valid Values: 0-9 DateFormat : YYYY Example : 2021 Allowable Values: 4

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: ProxyNumber
children.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005

children.name: EncryptedData
children.description: Encrypted Payload calculated over a the field values of Input.
